installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# Project Reclaimer (Halo 3) dedicated server: Pterodactyl install script.
# Downloads the server-only build from the official releases, checks it
# against the release's SHA256SUMS.txt and writes reclaimer-start.sh.
# Reinstalling updates both and keeps dedicated.toml, game/ and the rest.
# Halo 3's game files can't be downloaded: upload them into game/.
set -euo pipefail
mkdir -p /mnt/server
cd /mnt/server

RELEASES=https://github.com/ProjectReclaimer/project-reclaimer-releases/releases
VERSION=${RECLAIMER_VERSION:-latest}
if [ "$VERSION" = latest ]; then
    BASE=$RELEASES/latest/download
else
    BASE=$RELEASES/download/v${VERSION#v}
fi

# "<sha256>  project-reclaimer-dedicated-v0.9.17.exe" (server-only build, 0.8.14+)
line=$(curl -fsSL --retry 3 "$BASE/SHA256SUMS.txt" | tr -d '\r' |
    grep -m1 -E '[ *]project-reclaimer-dedicated-v[^ ]+\.exe$') || {
    echo "No server build listed in $BASE/SHA256SUMS.txt. Check the Project Reclaimer Version variable."
    exit 1
}
sum=${line%% *}
asset=${line##*[ *]}

echo "Downloading $asset"
curl -fsSL --retry 3 -o project-reclaimer.exe.part "$BASE/$asset"
echo "$sum  project-reclaimer.exe.part" | sha256sum -c -
mv -f project-reclaimer.exe.part project-reclaimer.exe
mkdir -p game

cat > reclaimer-start.sh << 'START_SH'
#!/bin/bash
# Project Reclaimer start script, written by the egg's installer (a reinstall
# rewrites it). The startup command execs it, so Pterodactyl's ^C (SIGINT)
# reaches the server, which stops cleanly on Ctrl+C.
cd /home/container || exit 1
EXE=./project-reclaimer.exe
trap 'exit 0' INT TERM

# An empty panel variable means "keep dedicated.toml's value". Unset those
# so a pinned older release never sees a variable name it doesn't know.
for v in ${!RECLAIMER_DEDICATED_@}; do [ -n "${!v}" ] || unset "$v"; done
# One panel server runs one Reclaimer server: the first [[server]] block.
export RECLAIMER_DEDICATED_ONLY=1

if [ ! -f dedicated.toml ]; then
    echo "[egg] First start: creating dedicated.toml, playlists/, content/ and bans.json"
    wine "$EXE" dedicated init . || exit 1
fi

# The first [[server]]'s port follows the allocation (UDP game, TCP RCON).
if [ -n "$SERVER_PORT" ]; then
    awk -v port="$SERVER_PORT" '
        /^[ \t]*\[\[[ \t]*server[ \t]*\]\]/ { n++; first = (n == 1); print; next }
        /^[ \t]*\[/ { first = 0 }
        first && /^[ \t]*port[ \t]*=/ { print "port = " port; next }
        { print }
    ' dedicated.toml > .dedicated.toml.egg
    if cmp -s dedicated.toml .dedicated.toml.egg; then
        rm -f .dedicated.toml.egg
    else
        mv -f .dedicated.toml.egg dedicated.toml
        echo "[egg] Set the first [[server]]'s port in dedicated.toml to $SERVER_PORT"
    fi
fi

# Wait until the game files and settings check out: upload Halo 3's files
# into game/ (and fix dedicated.toml) while this runs, no restart needed.
last=
until report=$(wine "$EXE" dedicated check 2>&1); do
    if [ "$report" != "$last" ]; then
        printf '%s\n' "$report"
        echo "[egg] Waiting for 'dedicated check' to pass, checking again every 15 seconds."
        last=$report
    fi
    sleep 15
done
printf '%s\n' "$report"

# Panel console: each line goes to this server's remote console (needs an
# RCON password). xargs keeps "quoted names" together and runs no shell.
exec 3<&0
while IFS= read -r line; do
    [ -n "${line//[[:space:]]/}" ] && printf '%s\n' "$line" | xargs wine "$EXE" dedicated rcon
done <&3 &

echo "[egg] Starting Project Reclaimer"
exec wine "$EXE" dedicated "$@" < /dev/null 3<&-
START_SH
chmod +x reclaimer-start.sh

echo "Installed $asset. Upload Halo 3's files into game/, then start the server."

variables.name: Project Reclaimer Version
variables.description: Release to install, such as 0.9.17, or latest. Applied on install and on Settings > Reinstall Server, which keeps your files. Players must run the same version as the server.

variables.name: Host Name
variables.description: Shown under the server's name in the Server Browser and in its lobby. Empty keeps dedicated.toml's setting (Dedicated server).

variables.name: Admins
variables.description: Player IDs (64 hex characters) who may kick and ban, separated by commas. Added to the admins in dedicated.toml. Players find theirs under Settings > Online services > Your player ID.

variables.name: Join Password
variables.description: Password players need to join. Empty keeps dedicated.toml's setting (none).

variables.name: Max Players
variables.description: Players admitted at once, 1-127, split-screen players included. Empty keeps dedicated.toml's setting (16). A max_players in the [[server]] block wins. Campaign co-op takes at most 16.

variables.name: Min Players
variables.description: Players the lobby waits for before a vote or game starts. Empty keeps dedicated.toml's setting (1).

variables.name: Welcome Message
variables.description: Chat line every player reads as they join; {name} and {server} are filled in. Empty keeps dedicated.toml's setting (none).

variables.name: Hidden
variables.description: true keeps the server out of the Server Browser: players join by address with Direct Connect. Empty keeps dedicated.toml's setting (false).

variables.name: Anti-Cheat
variables.description: enforce (kicks), detect (logs only) or off. Empty keeps dedicated.toml's setting (enforce).

variables.name: Block VPNs
variables.description: true refuses players on a VPN, proxy or hosting provider. Empty keeps dedicated.toml's setting (true).

variables.name: Max Ping
variables.description: Highest ping in milliseconds a player may join with, up to 1000; 0 takes everyone. Empty keeps dedicated.toml's setting (0).

variables.name: Player Votes
variables.description: Players may vote to kick, end the round or game, and shuffle teams. Empty keeps dedicated.toml's setting (true).

variables.name: Text Chat
variables.description: Empty keeps dedicated.toml's setting (true).

variables.name: Voice Chat
variables.description: Empty keeps dedicated.toml's setting (true).

variables.name: Team Changing
variables.description: balanced (only to a smaller team), game_type (as each game type allows) or off. Empty keeps dedicated.toml's setting (balanced).

variables.name: Friendly Fire
variables.description: false stops teammates and co-op partners hurting each other. Empty keeps dedicated.toml's setting (true: the game type decides).

variables.name: Share Mods
variables.description: true lets players download this server's mods from it. Empty keeps dedicated.toml's setting (false).

variables.name: Share Rate
variables.description: Upload limit for mod downloads together, in Mbit/s; 0 is no limit. Empty keeps dedicated.toml's setting (20).

variables.name: RCON Password
variables.description: 8-128 characters. Turns on the remote console, which the panel console uses to send commands (status, players, kick, ban, map...). Empty keeps dedicated.toml's [rcon] password (none: off).

variables.name: RCON Address
variables.description: 127.0.0.1 keeps RCON inside the container; the panel console still works. 0.0.0.0 also opens it on this allocation's TCP port for outside tools (unencrypted). Empty keeps dedicated.toml's setting (127.0.0.1).

variables.name: Public Address
variables.description: IPv4 address or DNS name players connect to. Empty detects it (api.ipify.org). Set it when the node's outgoing address isn't this allocation's.

variables.name: Auto Update
variables.description: true installs each new stable release by itself and restarts (games in progress end). Empty keeps dedicated.toml's setting (false). Otherwise update with Reinstall Server.

variables.name: Wine Packages
variables.description: Winetricks verbs the image installs into the Wine prefix before each start (skipped once installed): the Visual C++ 2015-2022 runtime the server needs.
